data.content: PLAN (Claude, 2026-07-02, lease hive-flow-abe0). DESIGN PRINCIPLE: the ledger IS Knots — verified that work_sdlc already has a global star-to-deferred transition with deferred_from_state tracking, priority 0-4, tags, notes, blocked_by/parent_of edges, lease-based owner identity, and discovery via kno ls --state deferred and kno ready. No parallel store is built. GROUNDING (verified in repo): (a) zero kno wiring exists in .claude/settings.json or hooks today; (b) router notes and flow-watchdog.cjs live under .hive-flow/data/ and are untracked runtime data, so discipline checks must be runtime hooks not CI tests; (c) .hive-flow/enforcement/deferrals/ is vestigial — enforcement.cjs only clears it, nothing writes it; (d) .claude/helpers are protected engine files (Codex-only patches) while scripts/, .claude/settings.json, CLAUDE.md, tests/ are implementer-editable; (e) SessionStart hooks run session-restore and sentinel-recovery via settings.json around lines 356-399, so a new SessionStart entry is additive JSON only. DELIVERABLES (single slice, 4 files): 1) NEW scripts/deferral-ledger.cjs with three subcommands: record (creates knot then sets state deferred, structured note with the six required fields Owner/Reason/Unblock/Priority/Source/Review; refuses with exit 1 listing missing fields; clear message if kno binary absent), digest (lists state=deferred knots plus deferral-tagged open knots with all six fields; silent exit 0 when empty; fail-open warning exit 0 if kno unavailable — used at SessionStart for post-compaction discoverability), check-note FILE (flags deferral prose — defer/deferral/deferred/residual/standing-deferred/leftover/backlog/when-convenient word-boundary regex — on lines lacking a hive-flow-xxxx knot id; warning-only exit 0 this slice to avoid false-positive blocking). 2) .claude/settings.json: add SessionStart hook running digest, add PostToolUse hook on Write/Edit that runs check-note when the written path is under .hive-flow/data/tmux-router/. 3) CLAUDE.md: new Deferral Ledger section — protocol is mandatory: every deferral gets a knot at the moment of deferral via the record subcommand, router notes must cite the knot id, review happens via the SessionStart digest and kno ls --state deferred. 4) NEW tests/deferral-ledger.test.mjs (node:test, mirrors tests/enforcement.test.mjs style): check-note positive/negative/knot-ref-suppression cases, record missing-field refusal, digest empty and populated and kno-missing fail-open paths, using a stub kno shim prepended to PATH in spawned children so no real ledger writes occur. IMPLEMENTATION-TIME RETRO-FILL (no repo files): create ledger records for the four known prose-only deferrals — provider rename/debrand standing deferral, old v3 embeddings/gastown leftover-dir hygiene, MCP-child session-id env plumbing harness design note, and the 6 pre-existing tests/enforcement.test.mjs drift failures — each with full six-field records; also record the vestigial enforcement deferrals directory cleanup as the first dogfooded ledger entry. NON-GOALS: no edits to protected .claude/helpers or untracked flow-watchdog.cjs; no hard-blocking PreToolUse gate yet (if review wants fail-closed later, that becomes a recorded deferral in the new ledger); no new state machine. RISKS: regex false positives (mitigated: warning-only, word boundaries, knot-id suppression); settings.json hook-array regressions (gate: cli settings-hook-wiring test suite must stay green); kno PATH absence in hook context (fail-open by design); no build needed — plain cjs/json/md so no engine-manifest interaction. COMPLEXITY: low-moderate, roughly 300-400 LOC including tests, one implementation session. TEST/GATE STRATEGY: node --test tests/deferral-ledger.test.mjs green; cli settings-hook-wiring suite green; live smoke of digest and check-note against a fixture note; then REVIEW_REQUEST routed to Codex with exact scope and gates per dual-operator protocol. No child knots needed — one coherent slice on this knot. Knot has no invariants to respect.
